title: Closed-type expansion tanks.
officialText:
Closed-type expansion tanks shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s
instructions. The size of the tank shall be based on the capacity of the hot-water-heating system. The minimum size of the tank
shall be determined in accordance with the following equation:
V = (0.00041T – 0.466)V / (P /P ) – (P /P ) (Equation 10-1)
t s a f a o
For SI:
V = (0.000738T – 0.03348)V / (P /P ) – (P /P )
t s a f a o
where:
Vt = Minimum volume of tanks (gallons) (L).
V = Volume of system, not including expansion tanks (gallons) (L).
